info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Indicator Retrieval API
info.description: The Payment Indicator Retrieval API is designed to provide insights into payment activities associated with specific customer accounts. By querying this endpoint, users can obtain valuable indicators that reflect the payment status and history of transactions for a given customer and account. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions, accounting software, and customer service applications that need to assess payment patterns. Typical consumers include operational teams aiming to enhance customer transparency and support decision-making processes regarding account management.

get.summary: Retrieve payment indicator for a specific account
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the payment indicator for a specific account identified by the provided customer and account IDs. Use this to understand the payment status related to the specified account.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the payment indicator for a specific account associated with a customer. It provides essential payment information that can be utilized for further processing or analytical purposes.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning payment indicator information.

GetPaymentIndicatorForAccountRequest.title: Payment Indicator
GetPaymentIndicatorForAccountRequest.description: Represents the payment indicator data for the specified account and customer.
